assets.name: theme-system
assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Production raster asset for iPhonePlay Windows appearance settings theme card. Reference image is style and composition guidance: recreate ONLY one miniature settings-window preview from the theme thumbnails, never the entire settings page or the outer selection card. Landscape 2:1 aspect ratio, straight-on orthographic. A polished miniature desktop window almost fills the frame with 5% padding, softly rounded 8px corners, fine border, small blue app icon in title bar, three tiny window controls at top right; narrow left navigation with 4 short abstract lines and one selected blue item; main content has a title stub and three understated form rows with toggles. No readable text, no labels, no checkmark badge, no phone, no perspective. Crisp restrained Windows 11 native style, subtle realistic soft shadow and understated light reflection, aesthetically refined, at 220x110 px still clear. This asset represents FOLLOW SYSTEM theme: the same window transitions along a clean diagonal divide from light cool gray/white on its left to charcoal blue-gray dark on its right, as in the reference system thumbnail. Background neutral faint cool gray. Both halves identical aligned layout.

assets.name: logo-v2
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a finished premium Windows app icon for iPhonePlay, an iPhone screen mirroring and remote control app. Square composition. A vivid azure-to-cobalt softly rounded square tile, with subtle Fluent depth, clean edges and a restrained inner light highlight. In the center one bold white rounded upright phone silhouette whose screen has a crisp blue triangular play symbol cut out; a slim offset translucent pale-blue screen plane behind the phone implies screen mirroring. Clear simple distinctive silhouette legible at 24px, professional desktop utility, balanced geometric proportions. Icon tile occupies 88% of canvas centered. No lettering, no wordmark, no Apple logo, no decorative particles, no exaggerated extrusion, no surrounding drop shadow. Transparent background outside the icon tile. Single icon only.
